_meta.description: 角色主題庫。涵蓋療育系、喜劇、冒險、競技、職場、美食、宇宙、成長等200+創意方向。每個 concept 均可搭配 story_arcs.json 的任一弧線類型生成畫面。

fields.arc_type: 對應 story_arcs.json 中的弧線 id
fields.act2_twist: 第二幕的溫和變化，必須是可視覺化、可延續、能提升療育感的小事件
fields.visual_core: 第一幕建立場景的視覺描述，以繁體中文撰寫，強調柔和構圖、可愛動作、舒服配色
fields.en: 給生成模型使用的英文場景概念句，需簡單清楚、避免複雜衝突

1: 冬日暖光 / winter warm light
新年小願望 / tiny new year wish
毛毯與熱茶 / blanket and tea
2: 柔粉色調 / soft pink palette
早春微風 / early spring breeze
4: 窗邊細雨 / rain by the window
嫩葉生長 / fresh green leaves
5: 初夏輕盈 / early summer lightness
8: 夏末柔光 / late summer glow
9: 初秋金光 / early autumn gold
10: 熱湯暖意 / warm soup comfort
11: 晚秋靜謐 / late autumn stillness
12: 小屋溫暖 / warm little house

clusters.kirby_trait: 重點是圓潤角色、植物、花朵、草地、舒服留白，像你給的參考圖那種單純看了就會放鬆的療育感。

concepts.zh: 坐在小花叢裡，讓蝴蝶停在鼻尖上
concepts.en: A cute character sitting in a small flower patch while a butterfly gently rests on its nose
concepts.visual_core: 主角圓圓地坐在花叢中央，四周是低矮小花與嫩草，表情放鬆開心，構圖簡單乾淨，背景留白
concepts.act2_twist: more tiny butterflies quietly gather around, creating a soft circle of color without disturbing the calm mood

concepts.zh: 頭上頂著一朵大花，安靜曬太陽
concepts.en: A chubby gentle creature wearing a giant flower like a hat and enjoying warm sunlight
concepts.visual_core: 圓潤角色坐在草地上，頭上是一朵大大的花，陽光從側邊落下，配色以粉綠與柔黃為主
concepts.act2_twist: the flower slowly opens wider and casts a cute petal-shaped shadow over the character's happy face

concepts.zh: 和小鳥一起澆花，水珠閃亮亮
concepts.en: A cute character watering flowers together with tiny birds in a sunny garden
concepts.visual_core: 角色拿著小澆水壺，旁邊兩三隻小鳥幫忙，花盆整齊排著，水珠在陽光下閃光，氣氛純淨
concepts.act2_twist: the falling water droplets catch the sunlight and briefly look like tiny sparkling beads around the flowers

concepts.zh: 躺在草地上，讓蒲公英飄過身邊
concepts.en: A soft round character lying on the grass while dandelion seeds drift by in the breeze
concepts.visual_core: 角色仰躺在綠草地上，閉眼微笑，身邊有幾朵蒲公英，畫面留很多呼吸感與柔和空白
concepts.act2_twist: the drifting seeds gently gather above like a tiny cloud before floating away again

concepts.zh: 蹲在草叢旁，和小蝸牛慢慢對看
concepts.en: A cute creature crouching beside the grass and calmly looking at a tiny snail
concepts.visual_core: 角色低低蹲著，與小蝸牛平視，草葉與小花圍成溫柔前景，整體色彩淡雅可愛
concepts.act2_twist: the snail slowly reaches one leaf toward the character like a tiny gift, making the scene even softer

clusters.kirby_trait: 聚焦在房間、抱枕、毛毯、熱飲、窗邊、桌燈這種非常安全的日常元素，療癒感比敘事張力更重要。

concepts.zh: 抱著枕頭在窗邊發呆，看雲慢慢飄
concepts.en: A fluffy character hugging a pillow by the window and quietly watching the clouds drift
concepts.visual_core: 角色坐在窗邊軟墊上抱著枕頭，窗外是淡藍天空與白雲，室內是奶油色與木質調，氛圍安定
concepts.act2_twist: a patch of sunlight slowly moves across the floor and reaches the character's feet like a warm companion

concepts.zh: 剛烤好的小餅乾，整盤捧在手上聞香味
concepts.en: A cute creature holding a tray of freshly baked cookies and happily smelling the warm sweetness
concepts.visual_core: 角色雙手捧著小餅乾盤，臉湊近熱氣，背景是簡單廚房與柔暖燈光，整體圓潤可口
concepts.act2_twist: one tiny cookie at the edge tips into the character's paw, making the smile grow even bigger

concepts.zh: 縮進毛毯裡，只露出圓圓的臉
concepts.en: A sleepy round character wrapped in a blanket with only its happy little face showing
concepts.visual_core: 大毛毯包住整個角色，只露出眼睛和笑臉，旁邊有熱可可與小書本，畫面極簡但很暖
concepts.act2_twist: the blanket softly puffs up as if the character has settled in even deeper, becoming even more irresistibly cozy

concepts.zh: 桌燈下認真畫塗鴉，旁邊放著彩色筆
concepts.en: A cute little creature doodling happily under a desk lamp surrounded by colorful pencils
concepts.visual_core: 木桌與小桌燈形成小小安全空間，角色專心畫圖，彩色筆散在桌面，線條與色塊都很溫柔
concepts.act2_twist: the finished doodle turns out to be a smiling self-portrait with tiny hearts around it

concepts.zh: 睡前把玩偶們排好，一起準備晚安
concepts.en: A sweet character arranging plush toys neatly before bedtime in a cozy room
concepts.visual_core: 角色在床上把幾隻小玩偶排成一排，床單柔軟蓬鬆，房間光線是暖黃夜燈，安全感很強
concepts.act2_twist: one plush toy leans against the character's side, making the bedtime scene feel even more loved

clusters.kirby_trait: 用甜點、水果、飲料、盤子、餐墊這些小物，做出簡單明亮的快樂，不需要複雜劇情。

concepts.zh: 抱著大草莓，笑得像今天沒有煩惱
concepts.en: A cheerful round creature hugging a giant strawberry with pure delight
concepts.visual_core: 角色雙手抱著大草莓，眼睛彎彎地笑，背景簡單留白，草莓紅與角色主色形成清爽對比
concepts.act2_twist: a few extra strawberries roll in around the character's feet like a tiny happy surprise

concepts.zh: 坐在甜甜圈上，把它當柔軟坐墊
concepts.en: A cute creature sitting on a big donut like it is the softest seat in the world
concepts.visual_core: 角色坐在大甜甜圈中央，糖霜柔和、色彩粉嫩，姿態放鬆又可愛，畫面一看就開心
concepts.act2_twist: colorful sprinkles gently tumble down around the donut like confetti, keeping the mood playful and light

concepts.zh: 和一杯奶昔靠在一起，像在一起休息
concepts.en: A soft creature leaning against a tall milkshake as if sharing a peaceful break together
concepts.visual_core: 角色靠著奶昔杯休息，吸管與奶泡都很圓潤，桌面乾淨，背景像咖啡店角落但極簡柔和
concepts.act2_twist: the whipped cream tilts slightly like a fluffy hat, making the milkshake feel like a cute silent friend

concepts.zh: 把小餅乾一片一片排成愛心
concepts.en: A cute character carefully arranging tiny cookies into a heart shape on the table
concepts.visual_core: 角色趴在桌邊，專心排著小圓餅乾，桌上有可愛餐墊與幾個散落的小點心，畫面工整溫柔
concepts.act2_twist: the last cookie drops perfectly into place, completing a heart shape that makes the whole table feel brighter

concepts.zh: 抱著暖呼呼的湯碗，臉也被蒸氣暖暖包住
concepts.en: A gentle character hugging a warm soup bowl while soft steam wraps around its smiling face
concepts.visual_core: 角色雙手抱著熱湯，熱氣上升，臉頰微紅，整體配色是奶白、南瓜橘、淡綠等舒服色調
concepts.act2_twist: the steam curls upward into tiny heart shapes before fading back into the air

clusters.kirby_trait: 不是冒險，而是可愛的小任務，例如提籃子、收果子、送花、整理桌面。讓角色看起來認真又可愛。

concepts.zh: 提著小籃子去採幾顆圓圓果實
concepts.en: A tiny cute creature carrying a basket and collecting round fruit in a sunny field
concepts.visual_core: 角色提著小籃子走在草地上，地上散著可愛圓果，步伐短短圓圓，畫面節奏輕快
concepts.act2_twist: the basket fills with colorful fruit faster than expected, making the little errand feel like a happy success

concepts.zh: 小心抱著一束花，要去送給朋友
concepts.en: A sweet creature carefully carrying a bouquet of flowers to deliver to a friend
concepts.visual_core: 角色雙手抱著大花束，花比身體還稍微大一點，表情認真溫柔，背景乾淨明亮
concepts.act2_twist: a few petals drift behind like a tiny trail, making the short walk feel extra gentle and lovely

concepts.zh: 把書桌上的彩色鉛筆一支支排整齊
concepts.en: A round little character carefully lining up colored pencils on a tidy desk
concepts.visual_core: 角色坐在桌前，把彩色鉛筆按色系排好，桌面整潔，畫面中有療癒的秩序感與低飽和色彩
concepts.act2_twist: the pencils end up forming a soft rainbow line that makes the desk feel even more cheerful

concepts.zh: 拿著小掃把，認真把落葉掃成一堆
concepts.en: A cute creature using a tiny broom to sweep fallen leaves into a neat little pile
concepts.visual_core: 角色拿著迷你掃把站在落葉旁，動作認真可愛，落葉顏色是秋日暖橘與金黃，畫面乾淨舒服
concepts.act2_twist: the leaf pile becomes perfectly round, matching the character's shape and making the task feel adorably complete

concepts.zh: 抱著小信封去門口，像在做很重要的事
concepts.en: A tiny happy creature carrying a little envelope to the front door like it is on a very important mission
concepts.visual_core: 角色雙手抱著信封，小步走向門口，門邊有鞋子與盆栽，場景非常日常但很可愛
concepts.act2_twist: the envelope turns out to have a hand-drawn heart on it, making the tiny mission feel extra warm and personal

clusters.kirby_trait: 用陽光、雨滴、雪、風、雲霧做出舒服心情，重點是角色和天氣互相陪伴，不是對抗。

concepts.zh: 穿著小雨衣，在細雨裡踩水窪
concepts.en: A happy round character in a tiny raincoat stepping in small puddles during a gentle drizzle
concepts.visual_core: 角色穿著可愛小雨衣與短靴，站在水窪邊，細雨很輕，地面反光柔和，表情單純開心
concepts.act2_twist: the puddle ripple forms soft little circles around the character's feet, making the rainy moment feel playful instead of cold

concepts.zh: 坐在雲朵邊邊曬太陽
concepts.en: A dreamy cute creature sitting on the edge of a fluffy cloud in warm sunlight
concepts.visual_core: 角色坐在柔軟雲朵上，天空是淡藍與奶白漸層，構圖空曠輕盈，療癒感強
concepts.act2_twist: a second smaller cloud drifts over and settles beside the character like a soft seat for company

concepts.zh: 冬天圍著圍巾，接住第一片雪花
concepts.en: A bundled-up cute character catching the first snowflake of winter with quiet delight
concepts.visual_core: 角色戴著圍巾與小手套站在白色背景前，神情期待，雪花少少落下，色調安靜又乾淨
concepts.act2_twist: the first snowflake lands gently on the character's paw and stays there for a tiny magical moment

concepts.zh: 被風吹得耳朵和葉子一起晃呀晃
concepts.en: A cute gentle creature swaying in the breeze while nearby leaves flutter the same way
concepts.visual_core: 角色站在草地上，耳朵或小配件被風吹動，幾片葉子在周圍輕輕飄著，畫面很有呼吸感
concepts.act2_twist: the leaves end up drifting into a loose circle around the character, echoing the same soft movement

concepts.zh: 霧霧的早晨裡，捧著一杯熱飲慢慢走
concepts.en: A calm cute character walking slowly through a misty morning while holding a warm drink
concepts.visual_core: 淡霧包住背景，角色捧著杯子慢慢走在小路上，顏色是灰藍、奶白、淡杏，畫面安靜舒服
concepts.act2_twist: the warm steam becomes the clearest shape in the mist, making the tiny walk feel even more comforting

clusters.kirby_trait: 讓角色與兔子、小鳥、貓咪、小狗、鴨子等小動物互動，主軸是陪伴與信任，不需要高衝突。

concepts.zh: 坐著不動，讓小鳥停在肩膀上
concepts.en: A gentle creature sitting very still while a tiny bird rests on its shoulder
concepts.visual_core: 角色安靜坐著，肩膀停著小鳥，表情彎彎笑，背景是幾片葉子與大面積留白
concepts.act2_twist: a second bird lands on the other side, balancing the whole scene into a sweet little portrait

concepts.zh: 把小胡蘿蔔分給兔兔一起吃
concepts.en: A cute round character sharing tiny carrots with a happy little rabbit
concepts.visual_core: 角色坐在地上，面前是一隻小兔子，兩邊共享小胡蘿蔔，眼神都是開心和放鬆的
concepts.act2_twist: the rabbit nudges one extra carrot back toward the character like a tiny thank-you gift

concepts.zh: 和小狗一起躺在地上看天空
concepts.en: A soft creature lying on the grass with a small dog while both look up at the sky
concepts.visual_core: 角色和小狗並排躺著，草地柔軟，天空簡單淡藍，畫面核心是輕鬆與陪伴
concepts.act2_twist: their tails and feet relax into the same easy pose, making the friendship feel naturally matched

concepts.zh: 伸手摸摸小貓，結果小貓主動蹭過來
concepts.en: A cute creature reaching out to pet a tiny cat, only for the cat to nuzzle in first
concepts.visual_core: 角色蹲低身體伸出手，小貓圓圓地靠過去，背景很乾淨，讓互動成為唯一焦點
concepts.act2_twist: the cat curls around the character's hand, turning the first hello into instant trust

concepts.zh: 和幾隻小鴨子排成一列慢慢散步
concepts.en: A cheerful little creature walking slowly in a line with several tiny ducklings
concepts.visual_core: 角色走在最前面，小鴨子一隻隻跟在後面，步伐小小圓圓，畫面節奏可愛明快
concepts.act2_twist: the last duckling hurries forward to close the gap, completing the cutest possible walking line

clusters.kirby_trait: 把睡意、枕頭、抱抱、柔光、安靜姿勢做成核心，這一類最適合簡單而高療癒的畫面。

concepts.zh: 趴在大葉子上睡午覺
concepts.en: A sleepy cute creature napping on a giant leaf in soft afternoon light
concepts.visual_core: 角色縮成一小團睡在大葉子中央，葉脈像天然床墊，光線柔和，色彩以嫩綠與淡黃為主
concepts.act2_twist: the leaf rocks slightly in the breeze like a tiny cradle, making the nap feel even more peaceful

concepts.zh: 睡在一堆抱枕裡，只看得到耳朵和笑臉
concepts.en: A tiny happy creature napping inside a pile of soft cushions with only its smiling face visible
concepts.visual_core: 抱枕堆成柔軟山丘，角色埋在中間，表情滿足，畫面色彩低飽和且圓潤可愛
concepts.act2_twist: one cushion gently slips into the perfect place, making the sleeping nest look even softer and fuller

concepts.zh: 靠著窗邊打瞌睡，陽光剛好照到臉
concepts.en: A sweet character dozing by the window as a warm sunbeam reaches its face
concepts.visual_core: 角色靠在窗邊小睡，窗框與地板是簡單木質感，光束明顯但柔軟，整體很安穩
concepts.act2_twist: dust motes float through the sunbeam, making the sleepy moment feel golden and softly magical

concepts.zh: 抱著小玩偶一起睡，像有雙倍安心
concepts.en: A cuddly character sleeping while hugging a tiny plush toy close to its chest
concepts.visual_core: 角色側躺睡著，小玩偶被緊緊抱住，床鋪蓬鬆，色調是奶油白和粉彩，療癒感很滿
concepts.act2_twist: the plush toy settles into the hug so perfectly that the whole pose looks extra tender and safe

concepts.zh: 睡在樹蔭下，旁邊還有一杯沒喝完的果汁
concepts.en: A sleepy round creature resting under a tree with a half-finished juice beside it
concepts.visual_core: 樹蔭形成自然遮罩，角色睡在草地上，身邊有一杯插著吸管的果汁，氣氛像舒服的夏日午後
concepts.act2_twist: a leaf drifts down and lands lightly on the cup, finishing the lazy afternoon scene perfectly

clusters.kirby_trait: 不是盛大派對，而是小型可愛慶祝，像生日帽、彩帶、小蛋糕、完成一件小事之後的快樂。

concepts.zh: 戴著小紙帽，守著一顆迷你蛋糕笑
concepts.en: A cute creature wearing a tiny paper party hat and smiling at a mini cake
concepts.visual_core: 角色坐在桌前，前面是一顆小蛋糕，紙帽可愛歪歪的，構圖簡單中心化，像一張溫柔小賀卡
concepts.act2_twist: the candle flickers softly and makes the character's eyes shine even brighter with simple joy

concepts.zh: 努力吹出一個最圓的肥皂泡泡
concepts.en: A cheerful little creature trying to blow the roundest soap bubble possible
concepts.visual_core: 角色拿著泡泡棒，嘴巴小小鼓起來，背景乾淨，透明泡泡反射出淡淡彩虹光
concepts.act2_twist: one bubble grows perfectly round and drifts up slowly, becoming the proud center of the scene

concepts.zh: 完成拼圖最後一塊時，開心得舉高高
concepts.en: A tiny cute creature lifting the final puzzle piece with pure excitement
concepts.visual_core: 角色坐在地板拼圖旁，最後一塊拼圖被小心舉高，畫面有成就感但依然溫柔可愛
concepts.act2_twist: the last piece clicks into place neatly, making the character's whole posture relax into happy satisfaction

concepts.zh: 頭上被灑了幾片彩紙，也還是笑得很甜
concepts.en: A happy little creature covered with a few pieces of confetti and smiling sweetly
concepts.visual_core: 角色站在中央，頭上和肩膀落著少量彩紙，背景留白，整體像簡單慶祝插畫
concepts.act2_twist: one bright confetti piece lands neatly on top like a tiny crown, making the scene extra adorable

concepts.zh: 收到一張手寫小卡片，開心得抱在懷裡
concepts.en: A gentle creature hugging a handwritten little card with quiet happy gratitude
concepts.visual_core: 角色雙手抱著小卡片，卡片上有簡單可愛圖案，臉上是很滿足的笑，色調柔和乾淨
concepts.act2_twist: the card opens slightly to reveal a tiny drawn heart, deepening the warmth of the moment without changing its simplicity

clusters.kirby_trait: 利用四季顏色和小配件做變化，不靠劇情，而靠季節本身的舒服感與角色的可愛表情支撐。

concepts.zh: 春天戴花圈，坐在嫩草上微笑
concepts.en: A cute creature wearing a flower crown and smiling softly on fresh spring grass
concepts.visual_core: 角色頭戴小花圈，坐姿穩穩的，草地嫩綠，整體是清新春天配色，畫面明亮但不刺眼
concepts.act2_twist: a few loose petals drift down and settle around the character like a naturally made spring frame

concepts.zh: 夏天抱著西瓜片，臉上全是清爽快樂
concepts.en: A cheerful little creature hugging a slice of watermelon with bright summer happiness
concepts.visual_core: 角色抱著大西瓜片，背景是簡單草地或白底，紅綠配色清爽，整體非常可口可愛
concepts.act2_twist: a tiny drop of watermelon juice rolls down, making the summer feeling even fresher and more playful

concepts.zh: 秋天把小南瓜排在腳邊當裝飾
concepts.en: A round cute character sitting among tiny pumpkins like cozy autumn decorations
concepts.visual_core: 角色坐在小南瓜旁，色彩以橘、奶白、墨綠為主，背景簡單，畫面像秋季療癒卡片
concepts.act2_twist: one smallest pumpkin tilts gently against the character, making the arrangement feel even more snug and cute

concepts.zh: 冬天圍圍巾喝熱可可，鼻尖紅紅的
concepts.en: A bundled-up sweet creature sipping hot cocoa in winter with a tiny rosy nose
concepts.visual_core: 角色圍著圍巾捧杯子，臉頰和鼻尖淡淡紅，背景可有少量雪點或乾淨白色，安全又可愛
concepts.act2_twist: the cup's steam rises slowly and softens the whole winter frame into an even gentler moment

concepts.zh: 四季的小配件都圍在身邊，像一年份的幸福
concepts.en: A cute creature surrounded by small seasonal items from spring, summer, autumn, and winter
concepts.visual_core: 角色坐在中央，四周是花瓣、西瓜、落葉、小雪花等四季元素，配置整齊可愛，像收藏畫面
concepts.act2_twist: the seasonal items settle into a soft balanced circle, making the whole scene feel complete and harmonious

clusters.kirby_trait: 如果你之後要做雙角色療癒圖，這組很適合。重點是彼此靠近、分享、陪坐，不要戲劇衝突。

concepts.zh: 兩個角色一起坐著分一塊小點心
concepts.en: Two cute characters sitting side by side and sharing one small treat peacefully
concepts.visual_core: 兩個圓潤角色並排坐著，中間放一塊小點心，構圖對稱，表情放鬆，色彩柔和舒服
concepts.act2_twist: they each hold the treat from one side at the same time, making the shared moment feel extra sweet and balanced

concepts.zh: 一起撐著一把小傘走路
concepts.en: Two tiny gentle characters walking together under one small umbrella
concepts.visual_core: 兩個角色靠得很近共撐一把小傘，小雨細細落下，地面反光溫柔，畫面很有照顧感
concepts.act2_twist: they lean a little closer under the umbrella, making the rainy walk look even safer and warmer

concepts.zh: 一個負責抱花，一個負責提籃子
concepts.en: Two adorable characters helping each other, one carrying flowers and the other holding a basket
concepts.visual_core: 雙角色分工合作，一個抱花一個提籃，步伐慢慢的，花園或草地背景乾淨舒適
concepts.act2_twist: they pause to look at each other with matching smiles, making the simple errand feel like shared happiness

concepts.zh: 一起睡在同一條大毛毯上
concepts.en: Two soft round creatures napping together on the same big blanket
concepts.visual_core: 兩個角色靠在一起睡在毛毯上，姿勢自然放鬆，配色低飽和，畫面滿是安穩感
concepts.act2_twist: one corner of the blanket folds over both of them like a tiny shared shelter

concepts.zh: 一起看著一顆剛亮起來的小燈
concepts.en: Two sweet characters quietly watching a tiny lamp turn on between them
concepts.visual_core: 兩個角色坐在昏暗但不陰沉的空間裡，中間有一盞小燈，光線柔柔擴散，氣氛溫暖
concepts.act2_twist: the small lamp glow spreads across both faces evenly, making the shared stillness feel extra comforting

clusters.kirby_trait: 保留一點奇幻，但一定要輕、柔、可愛。魔法不是震撼，而是讓畫面變得更舒服一點點。

concepts.zh: 手心裡浮起一顆小小發光星星
concepts.en: A gentle cute creature holding a tiny glowing star floating above its paw
concepts.visual_core: 角色雙手捧著一顆小光星，背景簡單偏暗但柔和，星光成為唯一焦點，感覺安靜又溫暖
concepts.act2_twist: the star glows just a little brighter and softly lights the character's entire smile

concepts.zh: 把澆水壺裡的水灑成一小道彩虹
concepts.en: A cute creature watering plants and accidentally making a tiny rainbow in the sunlight
concepts.visual_core: 角色拿著小澆水壺，植物在前景，陽光斜照，水流很細，整體明亮溫柔
concepts.act2_twist: the water catches the light perfectly and forms a soft miniature rainbow above the leaves

concepts.zh: 睡著時，身邊冒出幾顆圓圓小星光
concepts.en: A sleeping round creature surrounded by a few tiny glowing stars in a calm dreamlike scene
concepts.visual_core: 角色安靜睡著，周圍只有少量小星光飄浮，背景簡單乾淨，夢境感很淡很柔
concepts.act2_twist: one little star drifts closer and rests beside the pillow like a tiny night companion

concepts.zh: 吹泡泡時，泡泡裡藏著淡淡花瓣光
concepts.en: A cute creature blowing bubbles that shimmer softly with petal-like light inside
concepts.visual_core: 角色輕輕吹泡泡，泡泡透明輕盈，裡面有淡淡粉色花瓣光感，畫面輕巧夢幻
concepts.act2_twist: the largest bubble reflects a tiny smiling version of the character, adding a playful magical touch

concepts.zh: 小燈串自己亮起來，把角落變得更安心
concepts.en: A cozy little creature watching string lights softly turn on and warm up a quiet corner
concepts.visual_core: 角色坐在房間角落，旁邊垂著簡單小燈串，色調柔暖，空間感小小的很安全
concepts.act2_twist: the string lights glow one by one until the entire corner feels like a tiny safe world

clusters.kirby_trait: 把日常城市角落變成小小冒險場景，強調移動感、偶遇感與一點點夜色或街頭節奏。

concepts.zh: 卡比站在便利商店門口，抱著熱飲看雨停
concepts.en: A cute round character standing outside a convenience store with a warm drink, waiting for the rain to stop under the neon glow
concepts.visual_core: 小夜雨、便利商店招牌反光、熱飲蒸氣與短暫停留的城市呼吸感。
concepts.act2_twist: the puddles begin reflecting the store lights so clearly that the sidewalk feels like a tiny second city under the character's feet

concepts.zh: 卡比在空蕩捷運車廂裡抱著小包包打瞌睡
concepts.en: A sleepy little character dozing gently on a nearly empty train car while hugging a tiny bag on its lap
concepts.visual_core: 車窗流動光影、安靜車廂、座椅重複節奏與旅途中短暫放鬆。
concepts.act2_twist: a warm stripe of station light slides across the seat and lands right on the character like a moving blanket

concepts.zh: 卡比在天橋上幫一排小盆栽擋風
concepts.en: A gentle pink character standing on a pedestrian bridge and shielding a row of tiny potted plants from a strong gust of wind
concepts.visual_core: 高處風感、橋面欄杆線條、微小守護行為與城市天空。
concepts.act2_twist: the plants lean back upright together once the wind passes, making the whole tiny rescue feel successful

concepts.zh: 卡比在夜市邊角排整齊小點心準備分享
concepts.en: A cheerful round character carefully lining up tiny street snacks on a night market counter, preparing to share them
concepts.visual_core: 夜市暖燈、桌面小物、排列帶來的滿足感與分享前的期待。
concepts.act2_twist: the final snack clicks into the last open spot and suddenly the whole arrangement looks like a perfect little festival display

concepts.zh: 卡比在大樓屋頂追著飛走的購物小票
concepts.en: A tiny determined character chasing a drifting receipt across a city rooftop as if it were a very important mission
concepts.visual_core: 屋頂風、城市天際線、輕巧追逐與滑稽認真感。
concepts.act2_twist: the receipt lands neatly on the character's head like a paper crown, turning the chase into a cute accidental victory

clusters.kirby_trait: 把燈光、裝飾、群眾氛圍與小小儀式感混在一起，偏歡樂、閃亮、可分享。

concepts.zh: 卡比抱著一串小燈籠坐在節慶入口等朋友
concepts.en: A cute character hugging a string of tiny lanterns while sitting near the entrance of a festival and waiting for a friend
concepts.visual_core: 燈籠層層光點、等待時的安靜期待、入口人流的朦朧背景。
concepts.act2_twist: the lanterns begin glowing one by one until the character is sitting inside a tiny pocket of warm light

concepts.zh: 卡比替小攤位把彩旗一面面扶正
concepts.en: A helpful little pink character straightening each strand of festival bunting above a tiny vendor stall
concepts.visual_core: 彩旗節奏、手忙腳亂卻認真的整理感、攤位即將準備好的歡樂前奏。
concepts.act2_twist: once the last flag is fixed, the entire stall suddenly looks complete and celebration-ready

concepts.zh: 卡比在煙火前先用耳罩抱住自己
concepts.en: A soft round character bracing gently with fluffy earmuffs just before the fireworks begin overhead
concepts.visual_core: 煙火未放前的停頓、表情預備動作、夜空即將被點亮的瞬間。
concepts.act2_twist: the first firework reflects in the character's wide eyes before it fills the whole sky

concepts.zh: 卡比和朋友一起把小紙星貼滿慶典牆面
concepts.en: Two adorable characters decorating a festival wall with tiny paper stars until the whole corner starts to glow with color
concepts.visual_core: 共同佈置、視覺累積、越貼越滿足的手作節奏。
concepts.act2_twist: the final cluster of paper stars forms a subtle heart shape without either character planning it

concepts.zh: 卡比在遊行散場後撿起一片亮晶晶彩紙當戰利品
concepts.en: A tiny cheerful character picking up one sparkling piece of confetti after the parade as if it were a precious trophy
concepts.visual_core: 散場後餘韻、地面反光、把小事看得很珍貴的可愛視角。
concepts.act2_twist: the confetti catches one last beam of light and becomes the brightest thing in the empty street for a second

clusters.kirby_trait: 題材偏童話式任務、漂浮感、遠景與奇幻目標，但仍保留可愛與溫柔，不走沉重戰鬥。

concepts.zh: 卡比背著小布包走向雲海裡唯一亮著的塔
concepts.en: A tiny pink traveler carrying a cloth satchel and walking toward the only glowing tower in a sea of clouds
concepts.visual_core: 遠方目標明確、雲海分層、旅途開始的安靜決心。
concepts.act2_twist: the tower light pulses softly back as if it noticed the traveler approaching

concepts.zh: 卡比在水面上撐著星星葉片當小船前進
concepts.en: A round dreamy character drifting across mirror-like water on a leaf shaped like a star
concepts.visual_core: 鏡面水面、漂浮旅程、安靜前進與天際倒影的夢感。
concepts.act2_twist: the water reflection reveals a second sky below, making the small voyage feel twice as magical

concepts.zh: 卡比在巨大的石階上拖著一顆會發光的小鈴鐺往上爬
concepts.en: A tiny determined character hauling a glowing little bell up a giant staircase one careful step at a time
concepts.visual_core: 巨型尺度、努力爬行、明確任務物件與安靜耐心。
concepts.act2_twist: the bell gives off a small reassuring glow each time it taps a step, making the climb feel less lonely

concepts.zh: 卡比在森林岔路前翻看手繪地圖卻被螢火蟲帶路
concepts.en: A cute explorer checking a hand-drawn map at a fork in the forest, only for a trail of fireflies to guide the way instead
concepts.visual_core: 岔路、手繪地圖、原本靠計畫後來改靠溫柔奇遇。
concepts.act2_twist: the fireflies arrange themselves into the same path shape as the map, confirming the new route

concepts.zh: 卡比把找到的小月亮碎片放回夜空模型中
concepts.en: A careful little character placing a found moon fragment back into a tiny model of the night sky
concepts.visual_core: 修復感、細緻手勢、宇宙元素縮小到桌面尺寸的溫柔奇幻。
concepts.act2_twist: the restored moon piece lights the rest of the model from within, turning the whole setup into a tiny cosmos

clusters.kirby_trait: 讓卡比扮演各種迷你職人或工作角色，重點是專注、笨拙可愛與完成工作的成就感。

concepts.zh: 卡比戴著超大安全帽在小工坊修一盞桌燈
concepts.en: A tiny diligent character wearing an oversized safety helmet while repairing a desk lamp in a cluttered workshop
concepts.visual_core: 工具台、維修中的專注感、角色與大型工具比例反差。
concepts.act2_twist: the lamp turns on at the exact moment the character leans back in relief, bathing the whole table in warm success

concepts.zh: 卡比當迷你甜點師把最後一顆糖珠放上蛋糕
concepts.en: A cheerful little pastry chef placing the final sugar bead on top of a cake with total concentration
concepts.visual_core: 甜點細節、最後一步的張力、完成前的屏息時刻。
concepts.act2_twist: the final sugar bead lands perfectly in the middle and suddenly the whole cake looks celebration-ready

concepts.zh: 卡比在小圖書角把借來的書排成彩虹順序
concepts.en: A soft round librarian-like character arranging returned books into a perfect rainbow sequence in a tiny reading corner
concepts.visual_core: 排列癖滿足感、書背色塊、靜靜把空間整理好的療癒感。
concepts.act2_twist: the final book slides into place and completes the color gradient across the whole shelf

concepts.zh: 卡比在科技實驗桌前替一顆會亮的小裝置接線
concepts.en: A careful pink technician connecting wires to a tiny glowing device on a clean laboratory bench
concepts.visual_core: 乾淨桌面、科技細節、面對未知裝置時的小心翼翼。
concepts.act2_twist: the device begins pulsing in the same rhythm as the character's smile, turning the test into a tiny triumph

concepts.zh: 卡比當花店小助手把緞帶綁到最後一束花上
concepts.en: A tiny flower shop assistant tying a ribbon around the final bouquet with patient little hands
concepts.visual_core: 束花手勢、緞帶收尾、工作完成前最後一個細節的溫柔專注。
concepts.act2_twist: the ribbon curls into the neatest shape and makes the bouquet look instantly gift-ready

clusters.kirby_trait: 題材偏玩具感、復古螢幕、塑膠質感與有點淘氣的節奏，適合做更跳脫的視覺變體。

concepts.zh: 卡比坐在老電視前等讀取畫面跑完
concepts.en: A patient little character sitting in front of an old television and watching a loading screen as if it were the most dramatic event in the room
concepts.visual_core: CRT 光、房間昏暗、等待本身變成一種好笑又懷舊的戲。
concepts.act2_twist: the loading icon suddenly matches the character's round shape, making the whole wait feel like a private joke

concepts.zh: 卡比把彩色積木排成超正式的冠軍頒獎台
concepts.en: A proud tiny character stacking colorful toy blocks into an overly serious championship podium
concepts.visual_core: 玩具房舞台感、誇張認真、孩子氣世界裡的英雄儀式。
concepts.act2_twist: the highest block wobbles but settles perfectly, turning the almost-fail into a triumphant finish

concepts.zh: 卡比在貼滿貼紙的遊戲桌下偷偷整理秘密寶物
concepts.en: A tiny mischievous character organizing a stash of secret treasures under a sticker-covered game table
concepts.visual_core: 桌下空間、私藏感、貼紙與玩具小物製造二刷細節。
concepts.act2_twist: one hidden sticker turns out to mirror the exact shape of the most treasured object in the stash

concepts.zh: 卡比對著夾娃娃機裡唯一一顆星星球沉思
concepts.en: A round character staring thoughtfully at the only star-shaped prize inside a claw machine
concepts.visual_core: 玻璃反光、獎品孤獨感、要不要出手的心理戲。
concepts.act2_twist: the star-shaped prize shifts just enough to look like it is staring back, making the machine feel strangely alive

concepts.zh: 卡比在彈珠台邊接住一顆差點飛走的亮球
concepts.en: A quick little character catching a pinball that almost shoots off the table like a tiny silver meteor
concepts.visual_core: 金屬反光、速度感、差點失手但最後接住的俐落可愛。
concepts.act2_twist: the ball lands in both paws at once and reflects the whole playroom in miniature on its surface
